name: Authority Exploitation
description: Authority is one of the most reliable psychological levers in social engineering. People are conditioned to comply with authority figures — inspectors, executives, IT administrators — even when those figures cannot be properly verified. Authority exploitation positions you in a role with implied or explicit authority over the target, then uses that authority to bypass normal security procedures. Confidence and specificity are the primary tools: a vague authority claim is easily challenged, while a specific and detailed one is rarely questioned.

blue.det: Requests that bypass normal process under claimed authority; pressure to skip verification steps; unusual visitor claiming executive access.
blue.cm: Written policy that no verbal authority overrides physical security verification; security awareness training; all visitors verified regardless of claimed seniority.
